basis: Independent derivation from frozen contract and the two existing product test methods before collector source was available.
scope: Pure stdlib orchestration fault decisions; no process, socket, Docker, native runtime, compiler, version or environment probes.

groups.decision: Only frozen ordinary hosted source and exact lock are admissible before create
Image content and platform roots are independent obligations
attacks: mutable tag substituted for immutable child
correct manifest with wrong config ID

groups.decision: Caller flags cannot authorize isolated execution
Archives may not escape, alias, expand above cap or plant runtime evidence
Only the exact disposable namespace may receive NET_ADMIN and the test flag
Exactly two exact methods must start and finish successfully inside one complete suite
attacks: boolean or string state masquerading as nil

groups.decision: Method success and each semantic fact must agree
Monotonic aggregate deadline and cleanup reserve dominate phase bounds
attacks: phase asks larger than available budget

groups.decision: Cleanup addresses retained owned CIDs and cannot erase uncertainty
attacks: cleanup deadline cannot start new work

limits: A passing control proves only these pure decisions for supplied fixtures. Real AMD64 Docker isolation, tool availability, artifact bytes, two product methods, namespace changes, migration state, OpenSSL activity, custody and actual cleanup remain unrun and unqualified.
